svg.title: KF and GRU estimation pipeline detail
svg.desc: Detail diagram of the state estimation pipeline: noisy measurement feeds an adaptive Kalman filter with gust augmentation, whose output feeds a two-layer GRU that learns the model residual, and both are fused into the final corrected state estimate.

g.text: Predict: x̂⁻ = Ad_aug · x̂ + Bd · u
